title: 2023 — #01 — Shibby Live Snippets (ORIGINAL)
description: The first in a newly planned AMSR mini-series of "Shibby Snippets" taken from my various live events each month. In each file I plan to collect and compile the best clips from each recording into a new and tantalisingly tingly listening experience for you all. * * * I have so many things to do to you, that I want to do to you, ways I want to play with you. Just relax and trust me to take care of you... And I'll make you happy and hazy by the time we're done together. Recording Date These snippets are taken from one of my live sessions at Chaturbate, which took place on the 17th of August in 2023.
author: Mistress Shibby
